stories.headline: UK economy grew 0.1% in August, beating expectations
stories.summary: The U.K. is grappling with a cost-of-living crisis sparked by sticky inflation and surging energy costs.

stories.headline: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
stories.summary: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.

stories.headline: How high inflation became a 'fact of life' in the U.S.
stories.summary: U.S. inflation has stayed elevated for years, raising concern at the Federal Reserve that consumers may come to expect stubbornly high prices.

stories.headline: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
stories.summary: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.

stories.headline: The latest inflation data is expected to show price increases are accelerating
stories.summary: Economists expect the consumer price index for September to rise 0.6% on the month and 3.6% year over year.
